stage.name: Stamina Training
stage.description:
Positional Football is a test of endurance, and good stamina can bring a significant tactical advantage.
<Random Team> Randomly encounter a Field, Tactical, or Straight Line team.
<Random Field> A Winter Field, Smart Stadium, Convection Storm, Twister Field, or standard field will appear at random.

light_rapid_crossbowman.name: Light Rapid Crossbowman
light_rapid_crossbowman.flavourText: A light crossbowman who can fire three bolts at once. The price of such on-demand firepower is their weakness in long-time battles.
abilities: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 3 bolts in the target's direction

entusiasta_lead_dancer.name: Entusiasta Lead Dancer
entusiasta_lead_dancer.flavourText: The lead dancer from a troupe invited by big companies to liven up Carnevale. Her skirt flickers like flame, warming the crowd and setting the streets ablaze—literally!
abilities: Invisible
Continuously deals Arts damage and Burn for the skill duration, Attack Range increases when Invisibility is lost
Loses Invisibility during Carnevale

volleyball_spiking_cart.name: Volleyball Spiking Cart
volleyball_spiking_cart.flavourText: A volleyball-spiking cart designed as a revenge against someone. Continuously makes powerful spikes at nearby people in an attempt to ruin all volleyball matches on the beach.
abilities: Gains increased ATK with each attack (up to a limit); when affected by certain Negative Statuses, these stacks will be lost

sarkaz_sentinel_leader.name: Sarkaz Sentinel Leader
sarkaz_sentinel_leader.flavourText: A seasoned Sarkaz mercenary who has been through many battles. They are responsible for scouting, patrolling, and issuing early warnings to the entire squad. Once attacked, the Herald will immediately issue a warning that Inspires the entire army, shifting allied Sarkaz on Standby into Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: When injured, issues an alarm to immediately enhance the ATK and DEF of all enemy units, and makes enemies in Standby immediately enter Combat-Ready mode

none_of_my_business.name: 'None of My Business'
none_of_my_business.flavourText: A drunken man wobbling around with his hat pulled low. The incendiary bombs lying around the battlefield have nothing to do with him. At least, that's what he's always insisted in his affidavits.
abilities: After losing a certain percentage of HP, releases a permanent incendiary field
Friendly Operators inside the field take True damage every second

field_shooter.name: Field Shooter
field_shooter.flavourText: This musbeast was recruited as shooter under the reasoning that if it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

basher_field_bludgeoner.name: 'Basher' Field Bludgeoner
basher_field_bludgeoner.flavourText: Can't lose if the opponent has no players left. If one swing doesn't... Nah, one swing always does it.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking your Operators.

field_goalie.name: Field Goalie
field_goalie.flavourText: This burdenbeast was recruited as goalkeeper under the reasoning that its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

field_bludgeoner.name: Field Bludgeoner
field_bludgeoner.flavourText: Can't lose if the opponent has no players left. If one swing doesn't do it, swing again.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking your Operators.

longshot_field_shooter.name: 'Longshot' Field Shooter
longshot_field_shooter.flavourText: This musbeast was recruited as shooter under the reasoning that if it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away. I mean really far away.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

brain_barrier_field_goalie.name: 'Brain Barrier' Field Goalie
brain_barrier_field_goalie.flavourText: This burdenbeast was recruited as goalkeeper under the reasoning that its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there. There is even the off-chance that it catches the ball between its horns.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

greater_armored_burdenbeast.name: Greater Armored Burdenbeast
greater_armored_burdenbeast.flavourText: Slow, docile, and even larger, these burdenbeasts obediently undergo rigorous training to perform tasks that go against their nature.
abilities: Will be tripped by a Stabilizer Chain, stunning itself and dealing Physical damage to nearby enemies.

army_shieldguard.name: Army Shieldguard
army_shieldguard.flavourText: Shieldguards of the Ursus Army. In the distance, a faint black line presses slowly forward. No one knows what their massive shields signify, only that screams keep coming from the cloud of dust in their wake.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; can fight 3 <Miner Guerrillas> at a time
Takes less damage when under a commander's orders

brave_palladulis.name: Brave Palladulis
brave_palladulis.flavourText: The hero Palladulis, played by two Minoans. They have become experts at playing Palladulis, working in perfect tandem to recreate his heroic charge. The one in front has gotten used to getting dazed from hitting walls, as the one in back cannot see what is in front of them.
abilities: Charges if there is an ally in the direction of its movement, dealing heavy Physical damage when it hits your unit
When Immersed, charge passes through allies until hitting terrain, taking heavy True damage and becoming stunned

dublinn_evocator_leader.name: Dublinn Evocator Leader
dublinn_evocator_leader.flavourText: An evocation caster leader in the Dublinn forces who can control fireballs, they are more adept at using Originium Arts than their underlings. Their leader's teachings reverberate in their minds as they work to purify the corruption of Terra in raging flames.
abilities: Controls <Purifying Flames> that move along the ground and explode after hitting a melee ally unit, dealing Arts damage and Burn; damage dealt decreases with distance moved

sarkaz_bladeweaver_leader.name: Sarkaz Bladeweaver Leader
sarkaz_bladeweaver_leader.flavourText: An elite Sarkaz mercenary who has mastered the combination of swordsmanship and Arts. The Originium flowing through their blood allows them to hold these crudely modified Arts-imbued greatswords. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they are capable of dealing melee attacks that inflict Arts damage while in Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.

suiton_master.name: Suiton Master
suiton_master.flavourText: A ninja that attacks by spinning in place. Claims that creating a vortex from air is a type of suiton too, even without water around him. Nobody wants to go out with him because he refuses to walk properly.
abilities: Deals Physical damage to surroundings while spinning, and stops spinning when shifted
Bounces <'Certain Fates'>

raging_man_eater.name: Raging Man Eater
raging_man_eater.flavourText: A biological weapon bred in a lab. Though a plant, it boasts astonishing bite force and digestive capabilities. What's even more terrifying is that they've started to appear in the wild.
abilities: Devours a surrounding unit but requires an extended period to digest on the spot before devouring again.

sarkaz_caster_leader.name: Sarkaz Caster Leader
sarkaz_caster_leader.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Caster. They use complex Arts to attack. Proceed with caution.
abilities: Uses chains to paralyze allied Operators.

sarkaz_worldcurser.name: Sarkaz Worldcurser
sarkaz_worldcurser.flavourText: An elite Sarkaz caster mercenary. Their Originium-wracked bodies have become convenient tools in their operations, and their accumulated resentment has crystallized into raw power. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they will cruelly expend their own life to complete their mission once in Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and attacks two targets with long-ranged Arts damage.

chalice_of_mortality.name: Chalice of Mortality
chalice_of_mortality.flavourText: Greater soul chalice born of a revenant's will, brimming with conviction immeasurable. The future, unforeseen but destined, is the ultimate verdict.
abilities: Flying unit.
Shares a fraction of the damage taken by non-aerial enemies around itself.

wooden_burdenbeast_of_ilion.name: Wooden Burdenbeast of Ilion
wooden_burdenbeast_of_ilion.flavourText: The wooden burdenbeast of Ilion, played by Minoan citizens. In the age of city states, Athenians captured the previously impregnable city of Ilion by hiding soldiers inside a wooden burdenbeast. The story is so well-known that a group of Minoans squeezing themselves into a vehicle is immediately understood as a recreation of the legend, and onlookers are invited to join in.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Carries up to 5 passengers
Movement Speed reduced for each additional passenger

r_11a_assault_power_armor.name: R-11a Assault Power Armor
r_11a_assault_power_armor.flavourText: A model equipped with long-ranged weapons, massively increasing its offensive capabilities. It's difficult to imagine what sort of changes might come about if this tech could be mass-produced.
abilities: Attacks 4 enemies simultaneously

slumber_companion_beast.name: Slumber Companion Beast
slumber_companion_beast.flavourText: Huge and strong companion beast in the neverwaking story that can float in mid-air. Sleeping on its fluffy back is considered the height of luxury in the Castle of Dreams, though its sense of direction has not gotten any better.
abilities: Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.
Carries any sleeping enemies or stunned Operators when passing through them, and puts them down after a while; taking up extra Block for the duration
Does not deduct Life Points when entering the Objective without carrying any units

active_sarkaz_caster_crystal.name: Active Sarkaz Caster Crystal
active_sarkaz_caster_crystal.flavourText: Originating from an archived enemy. The Originium body of these Sarkaz casters allows them to use previously unknown forms of Arts to interfere with our deployment, significantly pressuring our defenses.
abilities: Temporarily halts your DP regeneration shortly after it enters the battlefield

sarkaz_lancer_leader.name: Sarkaz Lancer Leader
sarkaz_lancer_leader.flavourText: A Sarkaz, more threatening than a normal Sarkaz Lancer. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.
abilities: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

static_oneiros_enemy_10080_mpiced_2.name: Static Oneiros β
static_oneiros_enemy_10080_mpiced_2.flavourText: Originating from an archived enemy. It seems unremarkable, but is able to strike before our operators take action. The mechanism by which it does so is associated with Originium.
abilities: Flying unit.
Shortly after it enters the battle, throws a bomb to temporarily disable the Operator with the highest DP cost in your Deployment Waiting Zone

rma70_spikeball.name: RMA70 Spikeball
rma70_spikeball.flavourText: A football that imitates RMA70 minerals to enrich the match experience. Its spikes are surprisingly benign. Players who have tried it say that kicking it is a highly interactive experience.
abilities: A standard football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

compressed_ball.name: Compressed Ball
compressed_ball.flavourText: A football made from compressed building materials to enrich the match experience. 'Heavy' doesn't begin to describe it. Do your foot a favor and don't bother kicking it.
abilities: A heavy football that is hard to move.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

deep_sea_slider_ball.name: Deep Sea Slider Ball
deep_sea_slider_ball.flavourText: A ball made in the image of a strange sea creature. Like its inspiration, it excretes a mucous slime, but it is unable to slide smoothly. Instead, it gets stuck in its own slime all the time.
abilities: Leaves behind sticky slime on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

fluffy_pink_balloon.name: Fluffy Pink Balloon
fluffy_pink_balloon.flavourText: A football that imitates a furry critter to enrich the match experience... Hey, where did it go? Okay, it's actually a real furry critter that's drifting through the air right now.
abilities: A very light football that can be easily moved.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

will_of_the_north_ball.name: Will of the North Ball
will_of_the_north_ball.flavourText: A ball made in the image of the indomitable will of the north. Like its inspiration, its mere presence summons snow and ice. Anyone up for a game of ice hockey?
abilities: Leaves behind slippery ice on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

leaking_beetleball.name: Leaking Beetleball
leaking_beetleball.flavourText: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, but this one seems to have a leak and keeps getting flatter as it rolls.
abilities: Becomes smaller when kicked, requiring less damage to move
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

perpetual_rebounder.name: Perpetual Rebounder
perpetual_rebounder.flavourText: A football inspired by an extremely unstable entity to enrich the match experience. It is as unpredictable as its inspiration, and has already been bouncing all over the field for half an hour... Somebody stop it, please!
abilities: A very bouncy football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

infused_originium_ball.name: Infused Originium Ball
infused_originium_ball.flavourText: A football that imitates infused... Hey, why is it moving? Okay, it's actually a genuine infused Originium slug. Genuinely explosive, too!
abilities: Chance to explode when kicked, stunning and damaging nearby units.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

bloated_beetleball.name: Bloated Beetleball
bloated_beetleball.flavourText: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, to scare away predators, but this just makes it all the more adorable to those present.
abilities: Becomes bigger when kicked, requiring more damage to move
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

originite_prime_ball.name: Originite Prime Ball
originite_prime_ball.flavourText: A football that looks like Originite Prime to enrich the match experience. Not actual Originium, so it is perfectly safe and does not explode.
abilities: Gives 3x score.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

floating_charged_ball.name: Floating Charged Ball
floating_charged_ball.flavourText: Football inspired by a flying machine in order to enrich the match experience. Its complex kinetic structure allows it to fly for extended periods when enough force is applied... What was its original purpose again?
abilities: Temporarily gains Flying when kicked.
